# Rating

```ts
import { Rating } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

A horizontal scale of numbered options — 1 to count — for satisfaction and Likert-style questions where the answer is one point on a scale. Each option can carry a caption ("Dissatisfied" … "Completely satisfied"), and an optional leading N/A lets people skip a question that doesn't apply. For a choice between named alternatives use RadioGroup; for picking a number from a range use Slider or NumberInput.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `RatingCount` | `5` | How many numbered options, 1 through count (Figma count, 2–10). Ignored when options is set. |
| `captions` | `string[]` | — | Captions for the numbered options, index-aligned with 1…count (e.g. ['No', 'Maybe', 'Yes']). Missing entries render without a caption. |
| `showCaptions` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the captions under the tiles (Figma showCaption). |
| `showNa` | `boolean` | `false` | Adds a leading "N/A" option, separated from the scale by a divider (Figma showNa). Its value is "na". |
| `naLabel` | `string` | `'N/A'` | Tile text of the N/A option. |
| `naCaption` | `string` | `'Unrated'` | Caption of the N/A option. |
| `options` | `RatingOption[]` | — | Full control over the scale: replaces count / captions, for custom values, labels, or per-option disabled. The N/A option (showNa) is still prepended. |

Also accepts all `Omit<
    React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof RadixRadioGroup.Root>,
    'children' | 'orientation' | 'asChild' | 'dir' | 'loop'
  >` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<Rating aria-label="How satisfied are you?" />
<Rating aria-label="Satisfaction" captions={['Dissatisfied', 'Indifferent', 'Satisfied']} count={3} />
<Rating aria-labelledby="q1" showNa captions={captions} />
<Rating aria-label="Would you recommend us?" value={answer} onValueChange={setAnswer} />
<Rating aria-label="Effort" count={10} showCaptions={false} />
<Rating aria-label="Locked answer" defaultValue="4" disabled />
```

## Accessibility

- Radix provides role="radiogroup" / role="radio", roving focus, and arrow keys that move and select — Tab enters and leaves the scale as one stop.
- Name the question: pass aria-label or aria-labelledby pointing at the visible question text. Without it the group is announced with no context.
- Each option's name is its value plus caption ("4 Generally satisfied"), so screen-reader users hear the meaning, not just the number.
- Selection isn't color-only: the selected tile changes fill and text color, and a disabled selection keeps a 2px ring.
- Focus is restyled (3px ring), never removed. Tiles are 48×40, above the 24px minimum target size.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Caption every point, or at least both ends, so the scale has meaning | Leave people guessing whether 1 is best or worst |
| Offer showNa when a question may not apply | Force an answer that skews results |
| Keep one direction: low → high, left → right | Mix scale directions between questions |
| Use 5 or 7 points for satisfaction, 10 for effort/likelihood | Use a Rating for named choices — that's RadioGroup |
